scope: Compositional requests grounded in persistent personal quantity facts, units, explicit focus, source conflicts, revisions and retractions; arithmetic through the existing learned numeric agent.
priors: local fragment-to-meaning demonstrations and independent admission
existing episodic store and authority/epoch preflight
explicit environment numeric demonstrations, not future answers
acceptance: all enabled-context development turns correct, including refusals
same-source revision replaces earlier value; conflicting sources are not silently merged
ambiguous focus and missing facts cause no numeric queries or memory writes
different units refuse before numeric execution; no automatic conversion
retraction cannot remove another source's observation
child born in a separate process inherits procedures but no parent personal facts
matched no-memory and no-composition controls retain their failures
all previous structural, dialogue, algorithm and compositional cases retained
live UI counters derive only from core receipts, unknown costs remain unavailable
not_completion: This is synthetic same-author development, not the independent-author Portuguese reserve required to close M1. It neither closes M1 nor starts M2. Quantity interfaces and unit equality are provided type semantics, not independently discovered physics or finance.
failure_rule: Preserve negative receipts. Do not weaken unit, source, ambiguity, teacher-isolation or existing regression checks to achieve approval.
